title: 第694章 缠斗第693章 恐怖血魔
slug: 被贬废丹房我偷偷无敌了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：被贬废丹房，我偷偷无敌了第一卷：默认第694章缠斗（..la）多亏四皇子身上的宝物众多，这才勉强抵挡住了两头血魔的围攻。
不过这些血魔时而化作一道血光，时而又散开变成一团血雾，反正各种形状变幻无穷，攻击人的时候还能让人陷入幻境。
这正是他们的难缠之处。
“哼！”陈长生冷哼一声，再次施展出来鲲鹏吞噬术，那两头血魔知道陈长生的厉害，嘭的一下散开，变成一团血雾，不退反进，朝陈长生扑了过来。
“来得好！”陈长生手一翻拿出一把大弓出来，这把弓正是血魂弓，拉开弓弦，箭矢正中血雾。
顿时间，血雾中发出惨叫之声。
“给我吞！”陈长生大袖一抖，顿时形成一个漆黑旋涡，把那两团血雾给吞了进去，他的鲲鹏吞噬术可以在任何地方以任何方式施展。
再次猎杀两头血魔，让陈长生实力暴涨，这种感觉实在是太好了，陈长生恨不得直接杀到血魔界去，吞个够。
接下来的时间，陈长生就四处猎杀血魔，这些血魔本来想着在这边大开杀戒，吃个够，哪里知道遇到了陈长生这样的煞星，也算是倒了血霉了。
不过战场的中央在李公公和血魔首领那里，此刻两人已经从大殿内打到外面，恐怖的攻击波顿时让皇宫损失不少，不少宫墙倒塌。
这也是没有办法的事情。
血魔首领实力非常强大，居然和李公公斗了个旗鼓相当，这要是多来两头，还真够大楚国喝一壶的。
在陈长生和乾坤龙卫以及其他高手的围攻下，那些血魔终于被全部猎杀干净，这些血魔被陈长生猎杀了一多半，其他的都被斩杀了，倒是让陈长生觉得有些可惜。
不过大楚国也损失惨重，死了好几名大臣，乾坤龙卫也死了好几个，甚至就连羽林卫也死了不少高手。
“多谢陈小友，要不是你，我们皇室只怕会损失更加惨重。”楚国皇帝感激道。
陈长生道：“陛下客气了，举手之劳罢了，我也没想到这些血魔这么难缠。”
皇帝道：“还请陈小友随我一起去到李公公那看看，顺便帮我们个忙，如果能够把那血魔首领斩杀就再好不过了。”
陈长生点点头，“好！不过我的实力低微，只能在一旁辅助，还请陛下不要把我当炮灰就好，我的分身虽然坐镇望仙宗，但毕竟不如本尊才是。”
开玩笑，那血魔首领能够和李公公斗个不相上下的人，自己才不会傻傻的去和他硬拼呢！
而且陈长生故意表明分身坐镇望仙宗，你们要是敢对自己阴谋算计，望仙宗高层肯定会知道的，到时候就是你们的末日。

“小友放心，自然不敢让你当炮灰，我观小友有克制血魔的手段，到时候或许可以帮上忙。”
大楚皇帝心中一凛，其实他之前确实存了不良的念头，但是陈长生表明有分身坐镇望仙宗，就让他不得不顾忌陈长生了。
不但不能够拿他当炮灰，而且还得把他保护好，要是出了差错自己也承受不住望仙宗的怒火。
“走！”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible. Volume 1: Default Chapter 694 Fighting (..la) Thanks to the numerous treasures on the fourth prince’s body, he could barely withstand the siege of the two blood demons.
However, these blood demons sometimes turn into a line of blood light, and sometimes disperse into a ball of blood mist. Anyway, the shapes are endlessly changing, and they can also make people fall into illusions when they attack people.
That's what makes them difficult.
"Hmph!" Chen Changsheng snorted coldly, and used the Kunpeng Devouring Technique again. Knowing Chen Changsheng's power, the two blood demons dispersed with a bang and turned into a ball of blood mist. They advanced instead of retreating and rushed towards Chen Changsheng.
"Well done!" Chen Changsheng flipped his hand and took out a big bow. This bow was the Blood Soul Bow. He pulled out the bowstring and the arrow hit the blood mist.
Suddenly, screams came from the blood mist.
"Swallow it!" Chen Changsheng shook his sleeves, and a dark vortex suddenly formed, swallowing the two masses of blood mist. His Kunpeng Devouring Technique can be used anywhere and in any way.
Hunting two blood demons again made Chen Changsheng's strength skyrocket. This feeling was so good that Chen Changsheng wished he could go directly to the blood demon world and devour them all.
In the following time, Chen Changsheng went around hunting blood demons. These blood demons originally wanted to go on a killing spree here to eat as much as they could, but they didn't know that they encountered evil stars like Chen Changsheng, which was considered bad luck.
However, the center of the battlefield was where Eunuch Li and the leader of the Blood Demon were. At this moment, the two men had already fought outside the palace. The terrifying attack caused a lot of damage to the palace, and many palace walls collapsed.
This is also something that can't be helped.
The leader of the Blood Demon is very powerful, and he actually fought evenly with Eunuch Li. If there were two more leaders, it would really be enough to make the Chu Kingdom drink a pot.
Under the siege of Chen Changsheng, Qiankun Dragon Guard and other masters, all the blood demons were finally hunted down. More than half of these blood demons were hunted by Chen Changsheng, and the others were beheaded, which made Chen Changsheng feel a little pity.
However, Dachu State also suffered heavy losses. Several ministers died, several Qiankun Dragon Guards also died, and even the Yulin Guards also lost many masters.
"Thank you Chen Xiaoyou. If it weren't for you, our royal family would have suffered even greater losses." The Emperor of Chu said gratefully.
Chen Changsheng said: "Your Majesty, you're welcome. It's just a little effort. I didn't expect these blood demons to be so difficult to deal with."
The emperor said: "I would also like to ask Xiaoyou Chen to come with me to Eunuch Li's house and do us a favor. It would be great if we could kill the blood demon leader."
Chen Changsheng nodded, "Okay! However, my strength is low and I can only assist from the side. Please don't treat me as cannon fodder. Although my clone is sitting in the Wangxian Sect, it is not as good as the original one after all."
Just kidding, if the Blood Demon leader can fight on a par with Eunuch Li, I won't be stupid enough to fight with him head-on!
Moreover, Chen Changsheng deliberately stated that his avatar is in charge of Wangxian Sect. If you dare to plot against you, the senior officials of Wangxian Sect will definitely know about it, and it will be the end of you.
"Don't worry, little friend. Naturally, I don't dare to let you be cannon fodder. I think that little friend has the means to restrain the blood demon. Maybe I can help you then."
The Emperor of Dachu was shocked. In fact, he did have bad thoughts before, but Chen Changsheng revealed that he had a clone to guard Wangxian Sect, so he had to worry about Chen Changsheng.
Not only cannot he be used as cannon fodder, but he must also be protected. If something goes wrong, he cannot bear the anger of Wangxian Sect.
"Walk!"
